verdict.rationale: GA4 documents event collection from websites, web and mobile apps, and connected devices, with Google tag snippets for web streams. Backend and offline events go through the HTTP Measurement Protocol, which supports server-to-server sends, an EU endpoint and 72-hour backdating. The Java/Python/Node.js/PHP/C#/Go/Ruby client libraries are for the reporting Data API, not ingestion, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: named official ingestion SDKs for major backend languages, a concretely documented mobile SDK, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-platform event sending.
